args.description: the far interior wall of a great Mycenaean palace hall at dawn, a row of thick red-painted wooden columns tapering downward standing before a plastered wall with painted friezes of spirals and griffins, hanging bronze shields between the columns, pale morning light from high openings, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile, a wide continuous band. Palette of warm limestone and dark wood lit by orange firelight, with cool night-blue shadows, the light turning pale gold. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
